title: Register on pregnancies in inflammatory rheumatic diseases Rhekiss (Rheumatism, child wish and pregnancy)
summary: Rhekiss is a nationwide observational study of female patients with inflammatory rheumatic diseases who are pregnant or wish to have a child. As a purely observational study, Rhekiss does not influence treatment decisions. These decisions are made exclusively by the treating rheumatologist together with the patients. Patients will not undergo any additional examinations, nor will Rhekiss influence decisions concerning their desire to have children, their pregnancy or breastfeeding. The aim of Rhekiss is to gather data on this periods and to analyse them with the goal of gaining insights into the course of pregnancies in women with inflammatory rheumatic diseases and the development of children during the first two years of life. Physicians and patients report data via separated accounts into a web-based application. The data entered are transferred in pseudonymized form in compliance to actual data protection regulations (DSGVO) to a firewall-secured database of a certified IT service provider in Nordrhine-Westphalia, where they are stored securely.
conditions: Persons encountering health services in circumstances related to reproduction

interventions.name:
There are no interventions. The study is an observational cohort study.
Online questionnaires on health status and current therapy are completed at set times (every six months until pregnancy, but for a maximum of two years).
